from pathlib import Path
import time
Path("evidence.py").write_text('"""Retain observations and calculate their arithmetic mean."""\n\ndef list_observations(records):\n    """Return the supplied observations, preserving real zero values and order."""\n    return list(records)\n\ndef mean_observations(records):\n    """Return the arithmetic mean of the supplied observation values."""\n    values = [record["value"] for record in list_observations(records)]\n    return sum(values) / len(values) if values else None\n')
gate = Path('.ui-communication-gate')
gate.mkdir()
(gate / "ready").write_text("Original owned command is waiting.\n")
print("Candidate written; waiting for UI receipt inspection.", flush=True)
try:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
    while not (gate / "release").exists():
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            raise TimeoutError("UI gate was not released within its declared bound")
        time.sleep(.05)
finally:
    for entry in gate.iterdir():
        entry.unlink()
    gate.rmdir()
print("UI inspection finished; original command completed.", flush=True)
